construction: Optimal marginal acquisition of new linear response functionals from learned laws and the complete retained interaction history

input_factor.method: Complete pivot Gaussian elimination; Markowitz ordering computed from learned entries.

initialization_arithmetic.exclusion: Integer modular arithmetic counted separately; gcd/bit operations, comparisons, storage and loop overhead not included in Fraction totals.

result.noise_amplifier_scope: If retained laws/history were exact and only each new response coordinate has error <=sigma, the scalar error is <=sigma times this number. This is not a noisy acquisition theorem for the learned laws or old history.
result.lower_bound_scope: Deterministic exact answers for every rational linear H in the unrestricted consistent-completion class, using rational full-vector forward queries. Extra structural or coefficient bit-size promises, source-code access, and randomized bounded-error algorithms are outside this lower bound.
